Press Release•October 14, 2026100 Kansas Republicans Are Now Backing Cindy Holscher for GovernorToday, the Cindy Holscher for Governor campaign announced that 80 additional current and former Republicans from across Kansas have endorsed Senator Cindy Holscher and joined “Republicans for Cindy,” bringing the coalition to 100 members. They joined the 20 current and former Republican elected officials who launched the coalition, many of whom served alongside both Holscher and Masterson in the legislature.
